items.title: Mose Allison Sr. Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know Dan Sane? [INTERVIEWEE] Dan Sane. I know of him.

ctx.x: Oh... Okay What about the music, did they have full bands?

Sure, they used to hold the band around in a wagon A can in a wagon, drum, bass, fillet, everything all in a wagon WC and we'd play in the Memphis blues, the St. Louis blues, yellow dog blues and all sorts of that The Wind Biot on the street, the Barthouse and Dan all up on... up and down the street Like that
Did those bands play with music or not? Would they have the music, sheet music in front of them?
